title: Strawberry Gluten-Free Glazed Grilllets
description: A delicious vegan BBQ dish featuring glazed grilllets and caramelized strawberries. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Glazed Grilllets (vegan)
ingredients.notes: Glazed with a mixture of maple syrup and apple cider vinegar

instructions: Season the Glazed Grilllets with salt and pepper.
Grill the Glazed Grilllets for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced strawberries and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the Glazed Grilllets with the caramelized strawberries and garlic.
Optional: garnish with fresh herbs or additional strawberries.
